hero.sr_title: FLORE Festival, the first gluten-free and lactose-free festival
hero.lede: A festival where everyone finally eats at the same table. Concerts, food court and wellbeing, all of it 100% gluten-free and lactose-free, no compromise.

concept.title_pre: A festival where everyone can finally
concept.intro: FLORE is the first 100% gluten-free and lactose-free festival. Concerts, DJ sets, food court, bar and shop: everything we love about a festival, without the usual sacrifices. A full day to dance, taste and enjoy, no second-guessing.

cards.title: 100% gluten-free
cards.text: The whole site, food court and bar included, is guaranteed gluten-free (below 20 ppm, the strictest standard). Safe even for coeliacs.

cards.title: 100% lactose-free
cards.text: Every dairy product is lactose-free or naturally without lactose, plus plant-based options. Real taste, no lactose.

cards.title: Music & food court
cards.text: Live concerts, DJ sets, food trucks and a bar. The full festival vibe, no compromise.

manifesto.quote: FLORE isn't a festival for people on a diet. It's a festival, full stop, that happens to be 100% gluten-free and lactose-free, so no one ever has to choose between having fun and eating with peace of mind.

geo.text: The venue is being chosen in eastern France, in a region built for travellers from all directions: an easy reach from Switzerland, northern Italy and southern Germany, as well as the rest of France.

chips.label: Northern Italy, a few hours away

visit.text: The venue isn't announced yet, but it's being chosen to stay easy to reach by car, train and plane, from France and its neighbouring countries alike. Full access details will follow the announcement.

items.a: FLORE is a one-day music and food festival, entirely gluten-free and lactose-free: concerts, DJ sets, a food court, a shop and wellbeing spaces, all on one site, all safe to eat and drink without a second thought.

items.q: Is it only for people with allergies or intolerances?
items.a: Not at all. FLORE is a festival for everyone, that happens to be 100% gluten-free and lactose-free. Think of it as any other festival: line-up, food, atmosphere, just without the usual dietary stress for those who need it.

items.q: When and where will it take place?
items.a: The exact date and venue will be announced soon. Sign up to the priority list below to be the first to know, before it's public.
Not yet. The priority list gives you early access and an early-bird price as soon as the box office opens.

items.q: Is the food really safe for coeliacs?
items.a: Yes. The whole site, food court and bar included, follows a strict below-20ppm gluten standard, the threshold recognised for coeliac disease, with dedicated preparation to avoid cross-contamination.

items.q: Do I need to travel far to get there?
items.a: No. The venue is being chosen in a region easily reached from Switzerland, northern Italy, southern Germany and all of France, by car, train or plane.
